#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1-portrait academic poster for Global Economic Prospects."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import textwrap

# --- A1 portrait at 150 DPI: 594mm x 841mm → 3508 x 4961 px ---
W, H = 3508, 4961
DPI = 150

# --- Color palette: institutional blues/teals + amber accent ---
BG_COLOR = (245, 248, 252)
HEADER_BG = (0, 51, 102)
SECTION_BG = (255, 255, 255)
CARD_BORDER = (195, 210, 228)
ACCENT_TEAL = (0, 118, 118)
ACCENT_AMBER = (200, 150, 0)
ACCENT_AMBER_LIGHT = (255, 243, 214)
RISK_RED = (170, 45, 25)
RISK_RED_LIGHT = (255, 237, 232)
TEXT_DARK = (25, 35, 50)
TEXT_MED = (65, 80, 100)
TEXT_LIGHT = (255, 255, 255)
DIVIDER = (195, 210, 228)
POLICY_BG = (232, 243, 250)
TEAL_LIGHT = (228, 246, 243)

def font(name, size):
    paths = {
        'bold': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Bold.ttf',
        'semibold': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Semibold.ttf',
        'medium': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Medium.ttf',
        'regular': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Regular.ttf',
        'light': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Light.ttf',
        'heavy': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Heavy.ttf',
    }
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(paths.get(name, paths['regular']), size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.truetype(paths['regular'], size)

MARGIN = 140
CONTENT_W = W - 2 * MARGIN
COL_GAP = 45


def rounded_rect(draw, bbox, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = bbox
    r = min(radius, (x1-x0)//2, (y1-y0)//2)
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y1, x1-r, y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0, y0+r, x0, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)


def wrap_text(draw, text, max_width, fnt):
    avg_char_w = fnt.getlength("M")
    wrap_chars = max(10, int(max_width / avg_char_w))
    return textwrap.wrap(text, width=wrap_chars)


def draw_text_wrapped(draw, text, x, y, max_width, fnt, fill, line_spacing=1.4):
    lines = wrap_text(draw, text, max_width, fnt)
    bbox = fnt.getbbox("Ag")
    line_h = bbox[3] - bbox[1]
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), line, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        y += int(line_h * line_spacing)
    return y


def draw_accent_bar(draw, x, y, w, h, color):
    draw.rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], fill=color)


def draw_flow_arrow(draw, x, y, color):
    """Draw a subtle downward chevron to guide the eye."""
    for i in range(3):
        draw.line([x - 20 + i, y, x, y + 14], fill=color, width=2)
        draw.line([x, y + 14, x + 20 - i, y], fill=color, width=2)


def create_poster():
    img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), BG_COLOR)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # === FONTS (scaled up) ===
    F_TITLE = font('heavy', 120)
    F_SUBTITLE = font('light', 58)
    F_ONELINER = font('regular', 42)
    F_SECTION = font('bold', 68)
    F_SUBSECTION = font('semibold', 50)
    F_BODY = font('regular', 42)
    F_BODY_BOLD = font('bold', 42)
    F_METRIC_VAL = font('heavy', 88)
    F_METRIC_UNIT = font('semibold', 34)
    F_METRIC_LABEL = font('regular', 36)
    F_SMALL = font('regular', 34)
    F_TAG = font('semibold', 32)
    F_FOOTER = font('light', 30)

    y = 0

    # ============================================================
    # HEADER
    # ============================================================
    header_h = 470
    draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, header_h], fill=HEADER_BG)
    draw.rectangle([0, header_h - 10, W, header_h], fill=ACCENT_AMBER)

    draw.text((MARGIN, 65), "Global Economic Prospects", font=F_TITLE, fill=TEXT_LIGHT)
    draw.text((MARGIN, 205), "Resilience Amid Uncertainty  |  World Bank Group", font=F_SUBTITLE, fill=(175, 205, 235))

    one_liner = "The global economy has staged its strongest recovery in six decades — but vulnerable economies lag behind as trade tensions cloud the outlook."
    draw_text_wrapped(draw, one_liner, MARGIN, 295, CONTENT_W, F_ONELINER, (195, 215, 238))

    y = header_h + 55

    # ============================================================
    # HEADLINE METRICS — visual centerpiece
    # ============================================================
    draw.text((MARGIN, y), "KEY FIGURES AT A GLANCE", font=F_TAG, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 60

    metrics = [
        ("STRONGEST IN", "6 DECADES", "Post-2020 Recovery"),
        ("1.2B", "YOUTH", "Entering Working Age"),
        ("1.5B", "PEOPLE", "Health Services Target"),
        ("300M", "PEOPLE", "Electricity in Africa"),
        ("300M", "FARMERS", "AgriConnect Target"),
        ("80M", "WOMEN", "Capital Access Target"),
    ]

    cols, rows = 3, 2
    card_w = (CONTENT_W - (cols - 1) * COL_GAP) // cols
    card_h = 230

    for row in range(rows):
        for col in range(cols):
            idx = row * cols + col
            cx = MARGIN + col * (card_w + COL_GAP)
            cy = y + row * (card_h + COL_GAP)

            is_hero = (idx == 0)
            bg = ACCENT_AMBER_LIGHT if is_hero else (255, 255, 255)
            bc = ACCENT_AMBER if is_hero else CARD_BORDER
            rounded_rect(draw, [cx, cy, cx+card_w, cy+card_h], 18, fill=bg, outline=bc, width=3)

            accent_c = ACCENT_AMBER if is_hero else ACCENT_TEAL
            draw.rectangle([cx+18, cy, cx+card_w-18, cy+7], fill=accent_c)

            val, unit, label = metrics[idx]
            draw.text((cx+40, cy+30), val, font=F_METRIC_VAL, fill=ACCENT_AMBER if is_hero else HEADER_BG)
            vw = draw.textlength(val, font=F_METRIC_VAL)
            draw.text((cx+40+vw+14, cy+65), unit, font=F_METRIC_UNIT, fill=TEXT_MED)
            draw.text((cx+40, cy+155), label, font=F_METRIC_LABEL, fill=TEXT_MED)

    y += rows * (card_h + COL_GAP) + 55

    # Flow indicator
    draw_flow_arrow(draw, W//2, y - 20, DIVIDER)

    # Divider
    draw.rectangle([MARGIN, y, W-MARGIN, y+2], fill=DIVIDER)
    y += 50

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 1: Recovery
    # ============================================================
    draw_accent_bar(draw, MARGIN, y, 7, 65, ACCENT_TEAL)
    draw.text((MARGIN+28, y), "A Historic Recovery — But Uneven", font=F_SECTION, fill=HEADER_BG)
    y += 100

    # Two-column layout for this text
    half_w = (CONTENT_W - COL_GAP) // 2

    recovery_text = (
        "The global economy has demonstrated notable resilience in the face of heightened trade tensions "
        "and policy uncertainty. Last year's faster-than-expected growth capped a recovery from the 2020 "
        "recession that is unmatched in six decades."
    )
    y1 = draw_text_wrapped(draw, recovery_text, MARGIN, y, half_w, F_BODY, TEXT_DARK)

    gap_text = (
        "However, this headline resilience masks a widening gap: vulnerable emerging market and "
        "developing economies (EMDEs) continue to lag significantly behind advanced economies. "
        "Growth could falter further if trade tensions escalate or financial market sentiment deteriorates."
    )
    y2 = draw_text_wrapped(draw, gap_text, MARGIN + half_w + COL_GAP, y, half_w, F_BODY, TEXT_MED)

    y = max(y1, y2) + 55

    # Flow indicator
    draw_flow_arrow(draw, W//2, y - 20, RISK_RED)

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 2: RISKS — strong visual weight
    # ============================================================
    risk_section_h = 680
    rounded_rect(draw, [MARGIN-12, y-12, W-MARGIN+12, y+risk_section_h], 22,
                 fill=RISK_RED_LIGHT, outline=RISK_RED, width=4)

    draw_accent_bar(draw, MARGIN+25, y+25, 7, 60, RISK_RED)
    draw.text((MARGIN+50, y+25), "Risks to the Outlook", font=F_SECTION, fill=RISK_RED)

    # Subheading
    draw.text((MARGIN + 50, y + 100), "Key downside risks threatening the recovery trajectory",
              font=font('medium', 38), fill=(140, 60, 40))

    ry = y + 160

    risks = [
        ("TRADE TENSIONS", "Escalation of tariffs and retaliatory measures could disrupt supply chains and dampen investment across global markets."),
        ("FINANCIAL VOLATILITY", "Deterioration in market sentiment could tighten financing conditions, especially for EMDEs with external dependencies."),
        ("INVENTORY CORRECTION", "Firms that front-loaded purchases are now drawing down stocks, reducing near-term aggregate demand."),
        ("CLIMATE SHOCKS", "Extreme weather events continue to threaten agricultural output and critical infrastructure in vulnerable regions."),
    ]

    risk_col_w = (CONTENT_W - 80 - COL_GAP) // 2
    for i, (rtitle, rdesc) in enumerate(risks):
        col = i % 2
        row = i // 2
        rx = MARGIN + 40 + col * (risk_col_w + COL_GAP)
        risk_y = ry + row * 250

        # Number marker
        draw.rectangle([rx, risk_y, rx+50, risk_y+50], fill=RISK_RED)
        draw.text((rx+14, risk_y+5), str(i+1), font=F_TAG, fill=TEXT_LIGHT)

        draw.text((rx+65, risk_y+5), rtitle, font=F_SUBSECTION, fill=RISK_RED)
        draw_text_wrapped(draw, rdesc, rx+65, risk_y+65, risk_col_w-65, F_BODY, TEXT_DARK)

    y += risk_section_h + 55

    # Flow indicator
    draw_flow_arrow(draw, W//2, y - 20, ACCENT_TEAL)

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 3: Policy Actions
    # ============================================================
    draw_accent_bar(draw, MARGIN, y, 7, 65, ACCENT_TEAL)
    draw.text((MARGIN+28, y), "Policy Actions for Sustained Growth", font=F_SECTION, fill=HEADER_BG)
    y += 105

    policies = [
        ("Trade", "Improve multilateral trade environment", "Diversify partners & products"),
        ("Finance", "Ease external financing for EMDEs", "Strengthen macro policy frameworks"),
        ("Climate", "Scale up climate risk mitigation", "Invest in resilient infrastructure"),
        ("Investment", "Catalyze private capital flows", "Remove structural bottlenecks"),
        ("Jobs", "Support cross-border labor mobility", "Enhance skills & labor flexibility"),
    ]

    tag_w = 220
    action_w = (CONTENT_W - tag_w - 2 * COL_GAP) // 2

    # Column headers
    draw.text((MARGIN+tag_w+COL_GAP, y), "Global Action", font=F_TAG, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    draw.text((MARGIN+tag_w+COL_GAP+action_w+COL_GAP, y), "Domestic Action", font=F_TAG, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 55

    row_h = 95
    for i, (area, glob_act, dom_act) in enumerate(policies):
        ry = y + i * row_h

        # Alternating subtle row background
        if i % 2 == 0:
            draw.rectangle([MARGIN, ry-5, W-MARGIN, ry+row_h-10], fill=(240, 246, 252))

        # Tag pill
        rounded_rect(draw, [MARGIN, ry+5, MARGIN+tag_w, ry+70], 12, fill=HEADER_BG)
        tw = draw.textlength(area, font=F_TAG)
        draw.text((MARGIN+(tag_w-tw)/2, ry+18), area, font=F_TAG, fill=TEXT_LIGHT)

        draw.text((MARGIN+tag_w+COL_GAP, ry+18), glob_act, font=F_BODY, fill=TEXT_DARK)
        draw.text((MARGIN+tag_w+COL_GAP+action_w+COL_GAP, ry+18), dom_act, font=F_BODY, fill=TEXT_DARK)

    y += len(policies) * row_h + 55

    # Divider
    draw.rectangle([MARGIN, y, W-MARGIN, y+2], fill=DIVIDER)
    y += 50

    # Flow indicator
    draw_flow_arrow(draw, W//2, y - 20, ACCENT_AMBER)

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 4: WB 2030 Strategic Priorities
    # ============================================================
    draw_accent_bar(draw, MARGIN, y, 7, 65, ACCENT_AMBER)
    draw.text((MARGIN+28, y), "World Bank 2030 Strategic Priorities", font=F_SECTION, fill=HEADER_BG)
    y += 100

    context_text = "With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the next decade, job creation is central to the World Bank Group's mission."
    y = draw_text_wrapped(draw, context_text, MARGIN, y, CONTENT_W, F_BODY_BOLD, ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 35

    priorities = [
        ("Health Services", "1.5B", "people", "Quality, affordable health services"),
        ("Mission 300", "300M", "people", "Electricity access in Sub-Saharan Africa"),
        ("AgriConnect", "300M", "farmers", "Move up the agricultural value chain"),
        ("Women's Capital", "80M", "women", "Women & women-led business capital access"),
        ("Water Forward", "1B+", "people", "Water security; 400M WBG commitment"),
    ]

    p_card_w = (CONTENT_W - 4 * COL_GAP) // 5
    p_card_h = 310
    for i, (pname, pval, punit, pdesc) in enumerate(priorities):
        px = MARGIN + i * (p_card_w + COL_GAP)

        rounded_rect(draw, [px, y, px+p_card_w, y+p_card_h], 16, fill=TEAL_LIGHT, outline=ACCENT_TEAL, width=2)
        draw.rectangle([px+16, y, px+p_card_w-16, y+6], fill=ACCENT_AMBER)

        # Big number
        draw.text((px+24, y+22), pval, font=font('heavy', 60), fill=HEADER_BG)
        vw = draw.textlength(pval, font=font('heavy', 60))
        draw.text((px+24+vw+8, y+40), punit, font=F_TAG, fill=TEXT_MED)

        # Name
        draw.text((px+24, y+100), pname, font=font('semibold', 32), fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

        # Desc
        draw_text_wrapped(draw, pdesc, px+24, y+145, p_card_w-48, F_SMALL, TEXT_MED, line_spacing=1.3)

    y += p_card_h + 55

    # Divider
    draw.rectangle([MARGIN, y, W-MARGIN, y+2], fill=DIVIDER)
    y += 50

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 5: Research Themes
    # ============================================================
    draw_accent_bar(draw, MARGIN, y, 7, 65, ACCENT_TEAL)
    draw.text((MARGIN+28, y), "Key Research Themes in Recent Issues", font=F_SECTION, fill=HEADER_BG)
    y += 105

    themes = [
        ("Fiscal Policy", "Rebuilding fiscal space through fiscal rules; fiscal challenges in small states"),
        ("Trade & Supply Chains", "High trade costs — causes and remedies; COVID-19 impact on global value chains"),
        ("Commodity Markets", "Commodity price cycles — drivers and policies; Russia-Ukraine energy implications"),
        ("Financial Spillovers", "Rising U.S. interest rates; fourth wave of rapid debt buildup"),
        ("Pandemic Economics", "COVID-19 impact on global income inequality; regional macro implications"),
    ]

    # 5 cards in a row
    theme_card_w = (CONTENT_W - 4 * COL_GAP) // 5
    theme_card_h = 220
    for i, (tname, tdesc) in enumerate(themes):
        tx = MARGIN + i * (theme_card_w + COL_GAP)

        rounded_rect(draw, [tx, y, tx+theme_card_w, y+theme_card_h], 14, fill=POLICY_BG, outline=CARD_BORDER, width=2)
        draw.rectangle([tx+14, y, tx+theme_card_w-14, y+5], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

        draw.text((tx+20, y+18), tname, font=font('semibold', 30), fill=HEADER_BG)
        draw_text_wrapped(draw, tdesc, tx+20, y+60, theme_card_w-40, font('regular', 28), TEXT_MED, line_spacing=1.3)

    y += theme_card_h + 30

    # ============================================================
    # FOOTER
    # ============================================================
    footer_h = 90
    footer_y = H - footer_h
    draw.rectangle([0, footer_y, W, H], fill=HEADER_BG)
    draw.rectangle([0, footer_y - 5, W, footer_y], fill=ACCENT_AMBER)

    draw.text((MARGIN, footer_y + 28),
              "World Bank Group  |  Global Economic Prospects Report Series  |  worldbank.org/gep",
              font=F_FOOTER, fill=(175, 205, 235))

    right_text = "Data-forward poster  |  A1 Portrait  |  2025 Edition"
    rw = draw.textlength(right_text, font=F_FOOTER)
    draw.text((W - MARGIN - rw, footer_y + 28), right_text, font=F_FOOTER, fill=(135, 165, 195))

    img.save('/app/output/final_poster.png', 'PNG', dpi=(DPI, DPI))
    print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}px at {DPI} DPI")
    print(f"A1 size: {W/DPI*25.4:.0f}mm x {H/DPI*25.4:.0f}mm")
    print(f"Content ends at y={y}, canvas height={H}, usage={y/H*100:.1f}%")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    create_poster()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1-portrait academic poster for Global Economic Prospects."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import textwrap

# --- A1 portrait at 150 DPI: 594mm x 841mm → 3508 x 4961 px ---
W, H = 3508, 4961
DPI = 150

# --- Color palette: institutional blues/teals + amber accent ---
BG_COLOR = (245, 248, 252)
HEADER_BG = (0, 51, 102)
SECTION_BG = (255, 255, 255)
CARD_BORDER = (195, 210, 228)
ACCENT_TEAL = (0, 118, 118)
ACCENT_AMBER = (200, 150, 0)
ACCENT_AMBER_LIGHT = (255, 243, 214)
RISK_RED = (170, 45, 25)
RISK_RED_LIGHT = (255, 237, 232)
TEXT_DARK = (25, 35, 50)
TEXT_MED = (65, 80, 100)
TEXT_LIGHT = (255, 255, 255)
DIVIDER = (195, 210, 228)
POLICY_BG = (232, 243, 250)
TEAL_LIGHT = (228, 246, 243)

def font(name, size):
    paths = {
        'bold': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Bold.ttf',
        'semibold': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Semibold.ttf',
        'medium': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Medium.ttf',
        'regular': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Regular.ttf',
        'light': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Light.ttf',
        'heavy': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Heavy.ttf',
    }
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(paths.get(name, paths['regular']), size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.truetype(paths['regular'], size)

MARGIN = 140
CONTENT_W = W - 2 * MARGIN
COL_GAP = 45


def rounded_rect(draw, bbox, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = bbox
    r = min(radius, (x1-x0)//2, (y1-y0)//2)
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y1, x1-r, y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0, y0+r, x0, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)


def wrap_text(draw, text, max_width, fnt):
    avg_char_w = fnt.getlength("M")
    wrap_chars = max(10, int(max_width / avg_char_w))
    return textwrap.wrap(text, width=wrap_chars)


def draw_text_wrapped(draw, text, x, y, max_width, fnt, fill, line_spacing=1.4):
    lines = wrap_text(draw, text, max_width, fnt)
    bbox = fnt.getbbox("Ag")
    line_h = bbox[3] - bbox[1]
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), line, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        y += int(line_h * line_spacing)
    return y


def draw_accent_bar(draw, x, y, w, h, color):
    draw.rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], fill=color)


def draw_flow_arrow(draw, x, y, color):
    """Draw a subtle downward chevron to guide the eye."""
    for i in range(3):
        draw.line([x - 20 + i, y, x, y + 14], fill=color, width=2)
        draw.line([x, y + 14, x + 20 - i, y], fill=color, width=2)


def create_poster():
    img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), BG_COLOR)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # === FONTS (scaled up) ===
    F_TITLE = font('heavy', 120)
    F_SUBTITLE = font('light', 58)
    F_ONELINER = font('regular', 42)
    F_SECTION = font('bold', 68)
    F_SUBSECTION = font('semibold', 50)
    F_BODY = font('regular', 42)
    F_BODY_BOLD = font('bold', 42)
    F_METRIC_VAL = font('heavy', 88)
    F_METRIC_UNIT = font('semibold', 34)
    F_METRIC_LABEL = font('regular', 36)
    F_SMALL = font('regular', 34)
    F_TAG = font('semibold', 32)
    F_FOOTER = font('light', 30)

    y = 0

    # ============================================================
    # HEADER
    # ============================================================
    header_h = 470
    draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, header_h], fill=HEADER_BG)
    draw.rectangle([0, header_h - 10, W, header_h], fill=ACCENT_AMBER)

    draw.text((MARGIN, 65), "Global Economic Prospects", font=F_TITLE, fill=TEXT_LIGHT)
    draw.text((MARGIN, 205), "Resilience Amid Uncertainty  |  World Bank Group", font=F_SUBTITLE, fill=(175, 205, 235))

    one_liner = "The global economy has staged its strongest recovery in six decades — but vulnerable economies lag behind as trade tensions cloud the outlook."
    draw_text_wrapped(draw, one_liner, MARGIN, 295, CONTENT_W, F_ONELINER, (195, 215, 238))

    y = header_h + 55

    # ============================================================
    # HEADLINE METRICS — visual centerpiece
    # ============================================================
    draw.text((MARGIN, y), "KEY FIGURES AT A GLANCE", font=F_TAG, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 60

    metrics = [
        ("STRONGEST IN", "6 DECADES", "Post-2020 Recovery"),
        ("1.2B", "YOUTH", "Entering Working Age"),
        ("1.5B", "PEOPLE", "Health Services Target"),
        ("300M", "PEOPLE", "Electricity in Africa"),
        ("300M", "FARMERS", "AgriConnect Target"),
        ("80M", "WOMEN", "Capital Access Target"),
    ]

    cols, rows = 3, 2
    card_w = (CONTENT_W - (cols - 1) * COL_GAP) // cols
    card_h = 230

    for row in range(rows):
        for col in range(cols):
            idx = row * cols + col
            cx = MARGIN + col * (card_w + COL_GAP)
            cy = y + row * (card_h + COL_GAP)

            is_hero = (idx == 0)
            bg = ACCENT_AMBER_LIGHT if is_hero else (255, 255, 255)
            bc = ACCENT_AMBER if is_hero else CARD_BORDER
            rounded_rect(draw, [cx, cy, cx+card_w, cy+card_h], 18, fill=bg, outline=bc, width=3)

            accent_c = ACCENT_AMBER if is_hero else ACCENT_TEAL
            draw.rectangle([cx+18, cy, cx+card_w-18, cy+7], fill=accent_c)

            val, unit, label = metrics[idx]
            draw.text((cx+40, cy+30), val, font=F_METRIC_VAL, fill=ACCENT_AMBER if is_hero else HEADER_BG)
            vw = draw.textlength(val, font=F_METRIC_VAL)
            draw.text((cx+40+vw+14, cy+65), unit, font=F_METRIC_UNIT, fill=TEXT_MED)
            draw.text((cx+40, cy+155), label, font=F_METRIC_LABEL, fill=TEXT_MED)

    y += rows * (card_h + COL_GAP) + 55

    # Flow indicator
    draw_flow_arrow(draw, W//2, y - 20, DIVIDER)

    # Divider
    draw.rectangle([MARGIN, y, W-MARGIN, y+2], fill=DIVIDER)
    y += 50

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 1: Recovery
    # ============================================================
    draw_accent_bar(draw, MARGIN, y, 7, 65, ACCENT_TEAL)
    draw.text((MARGIN+28, y), "A Historic Recovery — But Uneven", font=F_SECTION, fill=HEADER_BG)
    y += 100

    # Two-column layout for this text
    half_w = (CONTENT_W - COL_GAP) // 2

    recovery_text = (
        "The global economy has demonstrated notable resilience in the face of heightened trade tensions "
        "and policy uncertainty. Last year's faster-than-expected growth capped a recovery from the 2020 "
        "recession that is unmatched in six decades."
    )
    y1 = draw_text_wrapped(draw, recovery_text, MARGIN, y, half_w, F_BODY, TEXT_DARK)

    gap_text = (
        "However, this headline resilience masks a widening gap: vulnerable emerging market and "
        "developing economies (EMDEs) continue to lag significantly behind advanced economies. "
        "Growth could falter further if trade tensions escalate or financial market sentiment deteriorates."
    )
    y2 = draw_text_wrapped(draw, gap_text, MARGIN + half_w + COL_GAP, y, half_w, F_BODY, TEXT_MED)

    y = max(y1, y2) + 55

    # Flow indicator
    draw_flow_arrow(draw, W//2, y - 20, RISK_RED)

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 2: RISKS — strong visual weight
    # ============================================================
    risk_section_h = 680
    rounded_rect(draw, [MARGIN-12, y-12, W-MARGIN+12, y+risk_section_h], 22,
                 fill=RISK_RED_LIGHT, outline=RISK_RED, width=4)

    draw_accent_bar(draw, MARGIN+25, y+25, 7, 60, RISK_RED)
    draw.text((MARGIN+50, y+25), "Risks to the Outlook", font=F_SECTION, fill=RISK_RED)

    # Subheading
    draw.text((MARGIN + 50, y + 100), "Key downside risks threatening the recovery trajectory",
              font=font('medium', 38), fill=(140, 60, 40))

    ry = y + 160

    risks = [
        ("TRADE TENSIONS", "Escalation of tariffs and retaliatory measures could disrupt supply chains and dampen investment across global markets."),
        ("FINANCIAL VOLATILITY", "Deterioration in market sentiment could tighten financing conditions, especially for EMDEs with external dependencies."),
        ("INVENTORY CORRECTION", "Firms that front-loaded purchases are now drawing down stocks, reducing near-term aggregate demand."),
        ("CLIMATE SHOCKS", "Extreme weather events continue to threaten agricultural output and critical infrastructure in vulnerable regions."),
    ]

    risk_col_w = (CONTENT_W - 80 - COL_GAP) // 2
    for i, (rtitle, rdesc) in enumerate(risks):
        col = i % 2
        row = i // 2
        rx = MARGIN + 40 + col * (risk_col_w + COL_GAP)
        risk_y = ry + row * 250

        # Number marker
        draw.rectangle([rx, risk_y, rx+50, risk_y+50], fill=RISK_RED)
        draw.text((rx+14, risk_y+5), str(i+1), font=F_TAG, fill=TEXT_LIGHT)

        draw.text((rx+65, risk_y+5), rtitle, font=F_SUBSECTION, fill=RISK_RED)
        draw_text_wrapped(draw, rdesc, rx+65, risk_y+65, risk_col_w-65, F_BODY, TEXT_DARK)

    y += risk_section_h + 55

    # Flow indicator
    draw_flow_arrow(draw, W//2, y - 20, ACCENT_TEAL)

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 3: Policy Actions
    # ============================================================
    draw_accent_bar(draw, MARGIN, y, 7, 65, ACCENT_TEAL)
    draw.text((MARGIN+28, y), "Policy Actions for Sustained Growth", font=F_SECTION, fill=HEADER_BG)
    y += 105

    policies = [
        ("Trade", "Improve multilateral trade environment", "Diversify partners & products"),
        ("Finance", "Ease external financing for EMDEs", "Strengthen macro policy frameworks"),
        ("Climate", "Scale up climate risk mitigation", "Invest in resilient infrastructure"),
        ("Investment", "Catalyze private capital flows", "Remove structural bottlenecks"),
        ("Jobs", "Support cross-border labor mobility", "Enhance skills & labor flexibility"),
    ]

    tag_w = 220
    action_w = (CONTENT_W - tag_w - 2 * COL_GAP) // 2

    # Column headers
    draw.text((MARGIN+tag_w+COL_GAP, y), "Global Action", font=F_TAG, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    draw.text((MARGIN+tag_w+COL_GAP+action_w+COL_GAP, y), "Domestic Action", font=F_TAG, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 55

    row_h = 95
    for i, (area, glob_act, dom_act) in enumerate(policies):
        ry = y + i * row_h

        # Alternating subtle row background
        if i % 2 == 0:
            draw.rectangle([MARGIN, ry-5, W-MARGIN, ry+row_h-10], fill=(240, 246, 252))

        # Tag pill
        rounded_rect(draw, [MARGIN, ry+5, MARGIN+tag_w, ry+70], 12, fill=HEADER_BG)
        tw = draw.textlength(area, font=F_TAG)
        draw.text((MARGIN+(tag_w-tw)/2, ry+18), area, font=F_TAG, fill=TEXT_LIGHT)

        draw.text((MARGIN+tag_w+COL_GAP, ry+18), glob_act, font=F_BODY, fill=TEXT_DARK)
        draw.text((MARGIN+tag_w+COL_GAP+action_w+COL_GAP, ry+18), dom_act, font=F_BODY, fill=TEXT_DARK)

    y += len(policies) * row_h + 55

    # Divider
    draw.rectangle([MARGIN, y, W-MARGIN, y+2], fill=DIVIDER)
    y += 50

    # Flow indicator
    draw_flow_arrow(draw, W//2, y - 20, ACCENT_AMBER)

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 4: WB 2030 Strategic Priorities
    # ============================================================
    draw_accent_bar(draw, MARGIN, y, 7, 65, ACCENT_AMBER)
    draw.text((MARGIN+28, y), "World Bank 2030 Strategic Priorities", font=F_SECTION, fill=HEADER_BG)
    y += 100

    context_text = "With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the next decade, job creation is central to the World Bank Group's mission."
    y = draw_text_wrapped(draw, context_text, MARGIN, y, CONTENT_W, F_BODY_BOLD, ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 35

    priorities = [
        ("Health Services", "1.5B", "people", "Quality, affordable health services"),
        ("Mission 300", "300M", "people", "Electricity access in Sub-Saharan Africa"),
        ("AgriConnect", "300M", "farmers", "Move up the agricultural value chain"),
        ("Women's Capital", "80M", "women", "Women & women-led business capital access"),
        ("Water Forward", "1B+", "people", "Water security; 400M WBG commitment"),
    ]

    p_card_w = (CONTENT_W - 4 * COL_GAP) // 5
    p_card_h = 310
    for i, (pname, pval, punit, pdesc) in enumerate(priorities):
        px = MARGIN + i * (p_card_w + COL_GAP)

        rounded_rect(draw, [px, y, px+p_card_w, y+p_card_h], 16, fill=TEAL_LIGHT, outline=ACCENT_TEAL, width=2)
        draw.rectangle([px+16, y, px+p_card_w-16, y+6], fill=ACCENT_AMBER)

        # Big number
        draw.text((px+24, y+22), pval, font=font('heavy', 60), fill=HEADER_BG)
        vw = draw.textlength(pval, font=font('heavy', 60))
        draw.text((px+24+vw+8, y+40), punit, font=F_TAG, fill=TEXT_MED)

        # Name
        draw.text((px+24, y+100), pname, font=font('semibold', 32), fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

        # Desc
        draw_text_wrapped(draw, pdesc, px+24, y+145, p_card_w-48, F_SMALL, TEXT_MED, line_spacing=1.3)

    y += p_card_h + 55

    # Divider
    draw.rectangle([MARGIN, y, W-MARGIN, y+2], fill=DIVIDER)
    y += 50

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 5: Research Themes
    # ============================================================
    draw_accent_bar(draw, MARGIN, y, 7, 65, ACCENT_TEAL)
    draw.text((MARGIN+28, y), "Key Research Themes in Recent Issues", font=F_SECTION, fill=HEADER_BG)
    y += 105

    themes = [
        ("Fiscal Policy", "Rebuilding fiscal space through fiscal rules; fiscal challenges in small states"),
        ("Trade & Supply Chains", "High trade costs — causes and remedies; COVID-19 impact on global value chains"),
        ("Commodity Markets", "Commodity price cycles — drivers and policies; Russia-Ukraine energy implications"),
        ("Financial Spillovers", "Rising U.S. interest rates; fourth wave of rapid debt buildup"),
        ("Pandemic Economics", "COVID-19 impact on global income inequality; regional macro implications"),
    ]

    # 5 cards in a row
    theme_card_w = (CONTENT_W - 4 * COL_GAP) // 5
    theme_card_h = 220
    for i, (tname, tdesc) in enumerate(themes):
        tx = MARGIN + i * (theme_card_w + COL_GAP)

        rounded_rect(draw, [tx, y, tx+theme_card_w, y+theme_card_h], 14, fill=POLICY_BG, outline=CARD_BORDER, width=2)
        draw.rectangle([tx+14, y, tx+theme_card_w-14, y+5], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

        draw.text((tx+20, y+18), tname, font=font('semibold', 30), fill=HEADER_BG)
        draw_text_wrapped(draw, tdesc, tx+20, y+60, theme_card_w-40, font('regular', 28), TEXT_MED, line_spacing=1.3)

    y += theme_card_h + 30

    # ============================================================
    # FOOTER
    # ============================================================
    footer_h = 90
    footer_y = H - footer_h
    draw.rectangle([0, footer_y, W, H], fill=HEADER_BG)
    draw.rectangle([0, footer_y - 5, W, footer_y], fill=ACCENT_AMBER)

    draw.text((MARGIN, footer_y + 28),
              "World Bank Group  |  Global Economic Prospects Report Series  |  worldbank.org/gep",
              font=F_FOOTER, fill=(175, 205, 235))

    right_text = "Data-forward poster  |  A1 Portrait  |  2025 Edition"
    rw = draw.textlength(right_text, font=F_FOOTER)
    draw.text((W - MARGIN - rw, footer_y + 28), right_text, font=F_FOOTER, fill=(135, 165, 195))

    img.save('/app/output/final_poster.png', 'PNG', dpi=(DPI, DPI))
    print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}px at {DPI} DPI")
    print(f"A1 size: {W/DPI*25.4:.0f}mm x {H/DPI*25.4:.0f}mm")
    print(f"Content ends at y={y}, canvas height={H}, usage={y/H*100:.1f}%")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    create_poster()

raw_arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1-portrait academic poster for Global Economic Prospects."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import textwrap

# --- A1 portrait at 150 DPI: 594mm x 841mm → 3508 x 4961 px ---
W, H = 3508, 4961
DPI = 150

# --- Color palette: institutional blues/teals + amber accent ---
BG_COLOR = (245, 248, 252)
HEADER_BG = (0, 51, 102)
SECTION_BG = (255, 255, 255)
CARD_BORDER = (195, 210, 228)
ACCENT_TEAL = (0, 118, 118)
ACCENT_AMBER = (200, 150, 0)
ACCENT_AMBER_LIGHT = (255, 243, 214)
RISK_RED = (170, 45, 25)
RISK_RED_LIGHT = (255, 237, 232)
TEXT_DARK = (25, 35, 50)
TEXT_MED = (65, 80, 100)
TEXT_LIGHT = (255, 255, 255)
DIVIDER = (195, 210, 228)
POLICY_BG = (232, 243, 250)
TEAL_LIGHT = (228, 246, 243)

def font(name, size):
    paths = {
        'bold': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Bold.ttf',
        'semibold': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Semibold.ttf',
        'medium': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Medium.ttf',
        'regular': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Regular.ttf',
        'light': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Light.ttf',
        'heavy': '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/lato/Lato-Heavy.ttf',
    }
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(paths.get(name, paths['regular']), size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.truetype(paths['regular'], size)

MARGIN = 140
CONTENT_W = W - 2 * MARGIN
COL_GAP = 45


def rounded_rect(draw, bbox, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = bbox
    r = min(radius, (x1-x0)//2, (y1-y0)//2)
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0+r, y1, x1-r, y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0, y0+r, x0, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=outline, width=width)


def wrap_text(draw, text, max_width, fnt):
    avg_char_w = fnt.getlength("M")
    wrap_chars = max(10, int(max_width / avg_char_w))
    return textwrap.wrap(text, width=wrap_chars)


def draw_text_wrapped(draw, text, x, y, max_width, fnt, fill, line_spacing=1.4):
    lines = wrap_text(draw, text, max_width, fnt)
    bbox = fnt.getbbox("Ag")
    line_h = bbox[3] - bbox[1]
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), line, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        y += int(line_h * line_spacing)
    return y


def draw_accent_bar(draw, x, y, w, h, color):
    draw.rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], fill=color)


def draw_flow_arrow(draw, x, y, color):
    """Draw a subtle downward chevron to guide the eye."""
    for i in range(3):
        draw.line([x - 20 + i, y, x, y + 14], fill=color, width=2)
        draw.line([x, y + 14, x + 20 - i, y], fill=color, width=2)


def create_poster():
    img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), BG_COLOR)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # === FONTS (scaled up) ===
    F_TITLE = font('heavy', 120)
    F_SUBTITLE = font('light', 58)
    F_ONELINER = font('regular', 42)
    F_SECTION = font('bold', 68)
    F_SUBSECTION = font('semibold', 50)
    F_BODY = font('regular', 42)
    F_BODY_BOLD = font('bold', 42)
    F_METRIC_VAL = font('heavy', 88)
    F_METRIC_UNIT = font('semibold', 34)
    F_METRIC_LABEL = font('regular', 36)
    F_SMALL = font('regular', 34)
    F_TAG = font('semibold', 32)
    F_FOOTER = font('light', 30)

    y = 0

    # ============================================================
    # HEADER
    # ============================================================
    header_h = 470
    draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, header_h], fill=HEADER_BG)
    draw.rectangle([0, header_h - 10, W, header_h], fill=ACCENT_AMBER)

    draw.text((MARGIN, 65), "Global Economic Prospects", font=F_TITLE, fill=TEXT_LIGHT)
    draw.text((MARGIN, 205), "Resilience Amid Uncertainty  |  World Bank Group", font=F_SUBTITLE, fill=(175, 205, 235))

    one_liner = "The global economy has staged its strongest recovery in six decades — but vulnerable economies lag behind as trade tensions cloud the outlook."
    draw_text_wrapped(draw, one_liner, MARGIN, 295, CONTENT_W, F_ONELINER, (195, 215, 238))

    y = header_h + 55

    # ============================================================
    # HEADLINE METRICS — visual centerpiece
    # ============================================================
    draw.text((MARGIN, y), "KEY FIGURES AT A GLANCE", font=F_TAG, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 60

    metrics = [
        ("STRONGEST IN", "6 DECADES", "Post-2020 Recovery"),
        ("1.2B", "YOUTH", "Entering Working Age"),
        ("1.5B", "PEOPLE", "Health Services Target"),
        ("300M", "PEOPLE", "Electricity in Africa"),
        ("300M", "FARMERS", "AgriConnect Target"),
        ("80M", "WOMEN", "Capital Access Target"),
    ]

    cols, rows = 3, 2
    card_w = (CONTENT_W - (cols - 1) * COL_GAP) // cols
    card_h = 230

    for row in range(rows):
        for col in range(cols):
            idx = row * cols + col
            cx = MARGIN + col * (card_w + COL_GAP)
            cy = y + row * (card_h + COL_GAP)

            is_hero = (idx == 0)
            bg = ACCENT_AMBER_LIGHT if is_hero else (255, 255, 255)
            bc = ACCENT_AMBER if is_hero else CARD_BORDER
            rounded_rect(draw, [cx, cy, cx+card_w, cy+card_h], 18, fill=bg, outline=bc, width=3)

            accent_c = ACCENT_AMBER if is_hero else ACCENT_TEAL
            draw.rectangle([cx+18, cy, cx+card_w-18, cy+7], fill=accent_c)

            val, unit, label = metrics[idx]
            draw.text((cx+40, cy+30), val, font=F_METRIC_VAL, fill=ACCENT_AMBER if is_hero else HEADER_BG)
            vw = draw.textlength(val, font=F_METRIC_VAL)
            draw.text((cx+40+vw+14, cy+65), unit, font=F_METRIC_UNIT, fill=TEXT_MED)
            draw.text((cx+40, cy+155), label, font=F_METRIC_LABEL, fill=TEXT_MED)

    y += rows * (card_h + COL_GAP) + 55

    # Flow indicator
    draw_flow_arrow(draw, W//2, y - 20, DIVIDER)

    # Divider
    draw.rectangle([MARGIN, y, W-MARGIN, y+2], fill=DIVIDER)
    y += 50

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 1: Recovery
    # ============================================================
    draw_accent_bar(draw, MARGIN, y, 7, 65, ACCENT_TEAL)
    draw.text((MARGIN+28, y), "A Historic Recovery — But Uneven", font=F_SECTION, fill=HEADER_BG)
    y += 100

    # Two-column layout for this text
    half_w = (CONTENT_W - COL_GAP) // 2

    recovery_text = (
        "The global economy has demonstrated notable resilience in the face of heightened trade tensions "
        "and policy uncertainty. Last year's faster-than-expected growth capped a recovery from the 2020 "
        "recession that is unmatched in six decades."
    )
    y1 = draw_text_wrapped(draw, recovery_text, MARGIN, y, half_w, F_BODY, TEXT_DARK)

    gap_text = (
        "However, this headline resilience masks a widening gap: vulnerable emerging market and "
        "developing economies (EMDEs) continue to lag significantly behind advanced economies. "
        "Growth could falter further if trade tensions escalate or financial market sentiment deteriorates."
    )
    y2 = draw_text_wrapped(draw, gap_text, MARGIN + half_w + COL_GAP, y, half_w, F_BODY, TEXT_MED)

    y = max(y1, y2) + 55

    # Flow indicator
    draw_flow_arrow(draw, W//2, y - 20, RISK_RED)

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 2: RISKS — strong visual weight
    # ============================================================
    risk_section_h = 680
    rounded_rect(draw, [MARGIN-12, y-12, W-MARGIN+12, y+risk_section_h], 22,
                 fill=RISK_RED_LIGHT, outline=RISK_RED, width=4)

    draw_accent_bar(draw, MARGIN+25, y+25, 7, 60, RISK_RED)
    draw.text((MARGIN+50, y+25), "Risks to the Outlook", font=F_SECTION, fill=RISK_RED)

    # Subheading
    draw.text((MARGIN + 50, y + 100), "Key downside risks threatening the recovery trajectory",
              font=font('medium', 38), fill=(140, 60, 40))

    ry = y + 160

    risks = [
        ("TRADE TENSIONS", "Escalation of tariffs and retaliatory measures could disrupt supply chains and dampen investment across global markets."),
        ("FINANCIAL VOLATILITY", "Deterioration in market sentiment could tighten financing conditions, especially for EMDEs with external dependencies."),
        ("INVENTORY CORRECTION", "Firms that front-loaded purchases are now drawing down stocks, reducing near-term aggregate demand."),
        ("CLIMATE SHOCKS", "Extreme weather events continue to threaten agricultural output and critical infrastructure in vulnerable regions."),
    ]

    risk_col_w = (CONTENT_W - 80 - COL_GAP) // 2
    for i, (rtitle, rdesc) in enumerate(risks):
        col = i % 2
        row = i // 2
        rx = MARGIN + 40 + col * (risk_col_w + COL_GAP)
        risk_y = ry + row * 250

        # Number marker
        draw.rectangle([rx, risk_y, rx+50, risk_y+50], fill=RISK_RED)
        draw.text((rx+14, risk_y+5), str(i+1), font=F_TAG, fill=TEXT_LIGHT)

        draw.text((rx+65, risk_y+5), rtitle, font=F_SUBSECTION, fill=RISK_RED)
        draw_text_wrapped(draw, rdesc, rx+65, risk_y+65, risk_col_w-65, F_BODY, TEXT_DARK)

    y += risk_section_h + 55

    # Flow indicator
    draw_flow_arrow(draw, W//2, y - 20, ACCENT_TEAL)

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 3: Policy Actions
    # ============================================================
    draw_accent_bar(draw, MARGIN, y, 7, 65, ACCENT_TEAL)
    draw.text((MARGIN+28, y), "Policy Actions for Sustained Growth", font=F_SECTION, fill=HEADER_BG)
    y += 105

    policies = [
        ("Trade", "Improve multilateral trade environment", "Diversify partners & products"),
        ("Finance", "Ease external financing for EMDEs", "Strengthen macro policy frameworks"),
        ("Climate", "Scale up climate risk mitigation", "Invest in resilient infrastructure"),
        ("Investment", "Catalyze private capital flows", "Remove structural bottlenecks"),
        ("Jobs", "Support cross-border labor mobility", "Enhance skills & labor flexibility"),
    ]

    tag_w = 220
    action_w = (CONTENT_W - tag_w - 2 * COL_GAP) // 2

    # Column headers
    draw.text((MARGIN+tag_w+COL_GAP, y), "Global Action", font=F_TAG, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    draw.text((MARGIN+tag_w+COL_GAP+action_w+COL_GAP, y), "Domestic Action", font=F_TAG, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 55

    row_h = 95
    for i, (area, glob_act, dom_act) in enumerate(policies):
        ry = y + i * row_h

        # Alternating subtle row background
        if i % 2 == 0:
            draw.rectangle([MARGIN, ry-5, W-MARGIN, ry+row_h-10], fill=(240, 246, 252))

        # Tag pill
        rounded_rect(draw, [MARGIN, ry+5, MARGIN+tag_w, ry+70], 12, fill=HEADER_BG)
        tw = draw.textlength(area, font=F_TAG)
        draw.text((MARGIN+(tag_w-tw)/2, ry+18), area, font=F_TAG, fill=TEXT_LIGHT)

        draw.text((MARGIN+tag_w+COL_GAP, ry+18), glob_act, font=F_BODY, fill=TEXT_DARK)
        draw.text((MARGIN+tag_w+COL_GAP+action_w+COL_GAP, ry+18), dom_act, font=F_BODY, fill=TEXT_DARK)

    y += len(policies) * row_h + 55

    # Divider
    draw.rectangle([MARGIN, y, W-MARGIN, y+2], fill=DIVIDER)
    y += 50

    # Flow indicator
    draw_flow_arrow(draw, W//2, y - 20, ACCENT_AMBER)

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 4: WB 2030 Strategic Priorities
    # ============================================================
    draw_accent_bar(draw, MARGIN, y, 7, 65, ACCENT_AMBER)
    draw.text((MARGIN+28, y), "World Bank 2030 Strategic Priorities", font=F_SECTION, fill=HEADER_BG)
    y += 100

    context_text = "With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the next decade, job creation is central to the World Bank Group's mission."
    y = draw_text_wrapped(draw, context_text, MARGIN, y, CONTENT_W, F_BODY_BOLD, ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 35

    priorities = [
        ("Health Services", "1.5B", "people", "Quality, affordable health services"),
        ("Mission 300", "300M", "people", "Electricity access in Sub-Saharan Africa"),
        ("AgriConnect", "300M", "farmers", "Move up the agricultural value chain"),
        ("Women's Capital", "80M", "women", "Women & women-led business capital access"),
        ("Water Forward", "1B+", "people", "Water security; 400M WBG commitment"),
    ]

    p_card_w = (CONTENT_W - 4 * COL_GAP) // 5
    p_card_h = 310
    for i, (pname, pval, punit, pdesc) in enumerate(priorities):
        px = MARGIN + i * (p_card_w + COL_GAP)

        rounded_rect(draw, [px, y, px+p_card_w, y+p_card_h], 16, fill=TEAL_LIGHT, outline=ACCENT_TEAL, width=2)
        draw.rectangle([px+16, y, px+p_card_w-16, y+6], fill=ACCENT_AMBER)

        # Big number
        draw.text((px+24, y+22), pval, font=font('heavy', 60), fill=HEADER_BG)
        vw = draw.textlength(pval, font=font('heavy', 60))
        draw.text((px+24+vw+8, y+40), punit, font=F_TAG, fill=TEXT_MED)

        # Name
        draw.text((px+24, y+100), pname, font=font('semibold', 32), fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

        # Desc
        draw_text_wrapped(draw, pdesc, px+24, y+145, p_card_w-48, F_SMALL, TEXT_MED, line_spacing=1.3)

    y += p_card_h + 55

    # Divider
    draw.rectangle([MARGIN, y, W-MARGIN, y+2], fill=DIVIDER)
    y += 50

    # ============================================================
    # SECTION 5: Research Themes
    # ============================================================
    draw_accent_bar(draw, MARGIN, y, 7, 65, ACCENT_TEAL)
    draw.text((MARGIN+28, y), "Key Research Themes in Recent Issues", font=F_SECTION, fill=HEADER_BG)
    y += 105

    themes = [
        ("Fiscal Policy", "Rebuilding fiscal space through fiscal rules; fiscal challenges in small states"),
        ("Trade & Supply Chains", "High trade costs — causes and remedies; COVID-19 impact on global value chains"),
        ("Commodity Markets", "Commodity price cycles — drivers and policies; Russia-Ukraine energy implications"),
        ("Financial Spillovers", "Rising U.S. interest rates; fourth wave of rapid debt buildup"),
        ("Pandemic Economics", "COVID-19 impact on global income inequality; regional macro implications"),
    ]

    # 5 cards in a row
    theme_card_w = (CONTENT_W - 4 * COL_GAP) // 5
    theme_card_h = 220
    for i, (tname, tdesc) in enumerate(themes):
        tx = MARGIN + i * (theme_card_w + COL_GAP)

        rounded_rect(draw, [tx, y, tx+theme_card_w, y+theme_card_h], 14, fill=POLICY_BG, outline=CARD_BORDER, width=2)
        draw.rectangle([tx+14, y, tx+theme_card_w-14, y+5], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

        draw.text((tx+20, y+18), tname, font=font('semibold', 30), fill=HEADER_BG)
        draw_text_wrapped(draw, tdesc, tx+20, y+60, theme_card_w-40, font('regular', 28), TEXT_MED, line_spacing=1.3)

    y += theme_card_h + 30

    # ============================================================
    # FOOTER
    # ============================================================
    footer_h = 90
    footer_y = H - footer_h
    draw.rectangle([0, footer_y, W, H], fill=HEADER_BG)
    draw.rectangle([0, footer_y - 5, W, footer_y], fill=ACCENT_AMBER)

    draw.text((MARGIN, footer_y + 28),
              "World Bank Group  |  Global Economic Prospects Report Series  |  worldbank.org/gep",
              font=F_FOOTER, fill=(175, 205, 235))

    right_text = "Data-forward poster  |  A1 Portrait  |  2025 Edition"
    rw = draw.textlength(right_text, font=F_FOOTER)
    draw.text((W - MARGIN - rw, footer_y + 28), right_text, font=F_FOOTER, fill=(135, 165, 195))

    img.save('/app/output/final_poster.png', 'PNG', dpi=(DPI, DPI))
    print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}px at {DPI} DPI")
    print(f"A1 size: {W/DPI*25.4:.0f}mm x {H/DPI*25.4:.0f}mm")
    print(f"Content ends at y={y}, canvas height={H}, usage={y/H*100:.1f}%")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    create_poster()
